svg.title: RFID Ballot Box Cover Tags — Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Full lifecycle from Manufacturer through Printer (M39), Warehouse Gate, Transit Gate, Station Kit, RO Desktop (M09), Archive Gate to DESTROYED after 15 years. Shows HSM lock icons at issuance, pairing, and every state transition. Shows Merkle anchor to P05 transparency log. Shows tamper detection path to ECC dispatch (M16) and LiveView alert. Legend bottom-right with shape vocabulary.
svg.text: Lifecycle pipeline, HSM anchoring, tamper detection, and ECC dispatch
